name: Hape Sweet Walks wooden doll stroller (BUG Israel)

warm-modern.reason: Estimate: wood stroller with a folding canopy, which is the right type, but dimensions, canopy colour and frame finish are not stated and Hape fabrics are often bright; one small photo only.

safety.source: BUG product page: no EN 71, CE or SI 562 mark stated. Age 2+ per the page

notes: KIDS SAFETY: EN 71 NOT STATED on the page (not stated, not confirmed absent). Hape is a major brand and normally tests to EN 71, but that must be confirmed from the brand or an import declaration before sale. Spec: wood, oat linen/cotton canopy (not pink), 30-34 x 45-50 x 45-52, no pinch points. Dimensions not published on this page. Real brand is allowed (only copies are rejected). Shipping to Israel: cheapest = free store pickup, or free standard delivery over 179 ILS (promo banner); fastest = free same-day delivery in the central region on orders over 799 ILS, per the banner; not verified. Image is a single small web image on the retailer's CDN; rights unclear.
